title: It's a (Blind) Match! Towards Vision-Language Correspondence without Parallel Data
tldr_zh: 把无平行数据的视觉-语言匹配写成 QAP，提出 factorized Hahn-Grant 求解器，实证基础模型嵌入可无监督结构对齐
tldr_en: Formulates blind vision-language matching as a QAP, proposes a factorized Hahn-Grant solver, and empirically shows unsupervised structural alignment of foundation model embeddings
